items.text: Bid compliance: assemble the tender as one PDF of no more than 20 pages and submit it via the portal by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC, ensuring the service is live for students by 2027-01-11.
items.basis: The deadline and page limit are set by the procurement process, and the live date aligns with the start of spring enrollment.

items.text: Service features: provide signing capabilities for all current desktop and mobile browsers, and integrate with the student records system using the existing REST API.
items.basis: Browser compatibility is baseline for web services, and the use of the REST API is the stated method for student system integration.

items.text: Signature management: log every signature event with user identity, time, and version while retaining all signed documents for ten years and sending reminders after 72 hours of inactivity.
items.basis: Automated logs and retention satisfy the record-keeping standards required for digital signing.

items.text: Operational excellence: maintain 99.5% service availability each month, with planned maintenance notified five working days before execution.
items.basis: The service availability and maintenance notification period ensure minimal disruption to user access.

questions.text: Should the supplier include templates for the twelve most used forms, and how would these be identified? Also, does the College require a formal quote for the migration of records by 2027-02-28?
Does the College prefer an on-premises deployment over the default cloud service, and what are the specific SLAs expected for severity-one incidents beyond the one-hour response goal?
